entries.title: Lifecycle
entries.contract: Pass an HTMLElement and EditorOptions with the explicit existing checkpoint identity, asset URL and local storage ports. createEditor returns a handle immediately; await ready before input. setReadOnly changes this view's editing gate. destroy returns unsaved and recovery information; choose flush or report and retain returned recovery bytes.
entries.errors: WASM loading, incompatible identity/schema or local recovery can reject readiness. Inspect state.error, preserve the checkpoint/journal and retry with compatible assets. A failed or closing view cannot accept commands.
entries.limits: Browser DOM and IndexedDB consumer only. SSR must not mount or access browser globals. React/Astro lifecycle tutorials remain pending; this is no SSR or native qualification.

entries.title: Document and prepared edits
entries.contract: read returns the engine Snapshot; it is a readback, not a second writable document. Supply a PrepareRequest to can or commit. Rust prepare/commit validates the request and returns CommitResult; inspect that result before reporting success. Re-read the committed snapshot for rendered content.
entries.errors: Read-only, stale targets, unsupported operations and permissions can reject work. Do not retry against a guessed range or overwrite a newer snapshot. Capture a fresh authorized target and preserve rejected source.
entries.limits: Only admitted schema/profile operations are valid. DOM edits and fabricated snapshots are not a public mutation API.

entries.title: Commands and history
entries.contract: Capture the command by its catalog name while the document target is current. The optional StableRange and focus owner identify the intended target. An unavailable capture returns undefined. History targets route undo/redo through the existing history owner. CommandChain's published methods prepare one Rust commit; do not infer Tiptap chain helpers or promise a method absent from these declarations.
entries.errors: A disabled command, invalid target, stale capture or read-only view cannot be treated as success. Release captures on dismissal and inspect returned command/commit outcomes. Peer and host-agent edits are not rewritten as local typing history.
entries.limits: The linked qualified consumer exercises bold, search/reorder and shared history. It does not qualify every exported command or arbitrary chain combination.

entries.title: Selection and captured targets
entries.contract: anchor takes a node ID, offset and optional Bias and returns an AnchorToken. Release it when finished. Capture a toolbar target before a host control moves focus; undefined means no usable target. Its state/applicable methods query the mark; format/apply/clear use the prepared command owner. Dispose the capture on dismissal.
entries.errors: Collapsed, stale, removed or protected targets may disable an action. Never turn a failed capture into an edit at the current DOM caret. Re-capture only after explicit user intent and a fresh selection.
entries.limits: Selection offsets and stable anchors follow the admitted core schema. Browser selection mechanics are not actual IME/assistive-technology or native proof.

entries.title: Events and state
entries.contract: subscribe has separate lifecycle-state and scoped Patch overloads. Retain and call the returned unsubscribe function. Lifecycle state exposes phase, readiness, readOnly, localCommitted and error. A visible preview is not readiness; a change notification is not a persistence receipt.
entries.errors: Handle state.error without deleting journal/checkpoint data. Unsubscribe before discarding a view and destroy it to release owned resources. Reentrant and late application work must respect the view lifetime.
entries.limits: Only actual localCommitted receipts describe local persistence. Patch, selection, transport send and ready events do not establish remoteCommitted durability.

entries.title: Local storage and recovery
entries.contract: flush accepts exactly target: local and returns a Promise<void>; observe state.localCommitted for its local receipt. recoveryExport returns bounded recoverable data. CheckpointStorage.open takes an IDBFactory and optional database name; publish takes a Checkpoint and exact covered update IDs. restore validates through the supplied engine callback. Close a separately opened store.
entries.errors: Quota, transaction failure, checksum/identity mismatch or recovery rejection require retaining the original bytes. Export a backup, repair capacity or assets and reopen compatibly. Do not silently clear storage or downgrade schemas.
entries.limits: CheckpointStorage is exported as an advanced browser adapter, not a hosted service. Its checkpointCommitted acknowledgment is distinct from a document localCommitted update and a qualified remote durability receipt.

entries.title: Synchronization attachment
entries.contract: attachSync takes host-owned transport, exact peer identity, current authorization and SyncSession options. Await its attachment; the host drives receive/pump for frames and retry deadlines and detaches when finished. Collaboration is explicitly enabled per editor and reuses the local replica/history.
entries.errors: Deny or revoke attachment when identity, schema, epoch or current authority mismatches. Detach and cancel stale callbacks; preserve local unsent edits. Retrying a transport is not authorization to replace document state.
entries.limits: PIN-1.3 uses a prepared local bridge and actual sync owner. Sending Yjs frames or convergence is not a durable remote-save receipt. No configured cloud host, anonymous proxy, or actual network/provider qualification is supplied.

entries.title: Qualified extension configuration subset
entries.contract: DocumentSearch and BlockReorder are typed factories; configure creates per-editor immutable configuration. EditorFacadeOptionsV1 connects the admitted extension/formatting/collaboration/platform/asset contract. The qualified consumer enables search/reorder in collaborative views and leaves them absent from the independent local note.
entries.errors: Invalid options, conflicts, unsupported schema/capabilities or missing host permissions must fail admission before attachment. Do not modify another editor's configuration or infer authority from a loaded shared asset.
entries.limits: This is the pinned Search/Reorder subset only. Full one-import catalogs, authoring recipes, other factories and managed-loading claims await their exact SDK-1.11/1.12 and EXT-1.20 deliveries. Export presence alone is not runtime qualification.
